problem_text:
A regional air tour company must schedule a scenic flight circuit covering 10 distinct landmarks.

The flight times between landmarks, in minutes, are precisely:
* Landmark Alpha to Bravo: 121.2 minutes
* Alpha to Charlie: 77.2 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 90.3 minutes
* Alpha to Echo: 104.7 minutes
* Alpha to Foxtrot: 106.8 minutes
* Alpha to Golf: 33.2 minutes
* Alpha to Hotel: 45.0 minutes
* Alpha to India: 117.8 minutes
* Alpha to Juliett: 56.0 minutes
* Bravo to Charlie: 196.6 minutes
* Bravo to Delta: 186.6 minutes
* Bravo to Echo: 225.2 minutes
* Bravo to Foxtrot: 152.6 minutes
* Bravo to Golf: 89.8 minutes
* Bravo to Hotel: 99.3 minutes
* Bravo to India: 32.0 minutes
* Bravo to Juliett: 98.7 minutes
* Charlie to Delta: 59.9 minutes
* Charlie to Echo: 29.5 minutes
* Charlie to Foxtrot: 120.9 minutes
* Charlie to Golf: 106.8 minutes
* Charlie to Hotel: 116.9 minutes
* Charlie to India: 195.0 minutes
* Charlie to Juliett: 126.3 minutes
* Delta to Echo: 80.2 minutes
* Delta to Foxtrot: 68.2 minutes
* Delta to Golf: 104.8 minutes
* Delta to Hotel: 135.1 minutes
* Delta to India: 194.8 minutes
* Delta to Juliett: 146.2 minutes
* Echo to Foxtrot: 146.0 minutes
* Echo to Golf: 135.5 minutes
* Echo to Hotel: 141.3 minutes
* Echo to India: 222.1 minutes
* Echo to Juliett: 149.9 minutes
* Foxtrot to Golf: 98.8 minutes
* Foxtrot to Hotel: 142.2 minutes
* Foxtrot to India: 171.0 minutes
* Foxtrot to Juliett: 152.7 minutes
* Golf to Hotel: 44.6 minutes
* Golf to India: 91.2 minutes
* Golf to Juliett: 54.4 minutes
* Hotel to India: 85.4 minutes
* Hotel to Juliett: 11.2 minutes
* India to Juliett: 81.4 minutes

The operational objective is to identify the most time-efficient flight sequence that commences from and concludes at the same landmark, ensuring each landmark is included in the itinerary precisely once.
